items.title: Cassius Wilson Interview, 1962-04-05
items.q: Well, the... Marais, I mean? No, they mostly, in olden times, when they turned out, they had black suits.

ctx.x: In olden times, did they spend much money on their clothes when they had the thick hair?

Well, the... Marais, I mean? No, they mostly, in olden times, when they turned out, they had black suits. They didn't turn out like these fellas turn out the day, but they all decorate umbrellas. You know how it cost them 15, 12 dollars to decorate one of them umbrellas? I'm telling you. Fans, they decorate their fans in the umbrellas. They have a fan umbrella and a basket. That's right. I want to see how they carry it all. Well, it's sad. They'll be having it. They don't need all that. I wouldn't want an…
It cost you a thousand dollars to hire enough policemen to take them away.
